mapper.select: SELECT cm.mcm_no, cm.mcm_count, cm.mcm_price, cm.mc_no, cm.mn_no, m.mn_name FROM cart_menu cm INNER JOIN mukja_cart c ON cm.mc_no = c.mc_no LEFT JOIN menu m ON cm.mn_no = m.mn_no WHERE cm.mc_no = #{mc_no} ORDER BY cm.mcm_no ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_menu ( mcm_no, mc_no, mn_no, mcm_count, mcm_price ) VALUES ( cart_menu_seq.NEXTVAL, #{mc_no}, #{mn_no}, #{mcm_count}, #{mcm_price} )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(r_no, 0) FROM mukja_cart WHERE mc_no = #{mc_no}
